fields.detail: Steer directive: the Lu reproducibility bundle (h14_3_reproducibility: Bautin-recurrence and center-basis scripts) is now the most valuable target in this workspace. Do NOT summarise the paper — verify or refute its finite computational core. (1) Re-derive the Bautin recurrence with exact arithmetic from the paper's own definitions. (2) Re-derive/check the center-basis check exactly. (3) State the finite core (Bautin-ideal membership / center-basis sign conditions) as a Lean theorem under code/lean/Lib/ and try to close it with the kernel (decide/norm_num/polyrith). (4) Report exactly which step you reproduced, which you could not, and what the paper leaves existential (the cyclicity bound B is existential — no explicit number). Evidence class of the paper: unrefereed preprint, asserted-by-source until verified.
fields.title: Independently verify/refute the finite computational core of Lu arXiv:2607.13785 (H14_3)

fields.reason: The target-inventory question is answered by the directive and the held sources in step: Roussarie–Rousseau 2015 leave exactly one graphic through a triple nilpotent point at infinity with no partial result, (H14_3); Lu arXiv:2607.13785 (Jul 2026, unrefereed) claims local uniform finite cyclicity of it. research/drr-list.md and the drr-status thread carry the answered inventory. The remaining live value is no longer the enumeration but the independent verification of Lu's computational core, which is now its own task (verify-lu-h14-3-finite-core). Full 121-row raw enumeration still blocked on DRR 1994 not being held — recorded as a gap, not as a task.

fields.detail: Directive 3 (SECOND): code/lean/Lib/BautinRecurrence.lean line ~90 defines P30 as the literal 0 with a placeholder comment, so the theorem 192*L6 + P30 = 0 is a statement about zero and proves nothing about the paper. Spell out all thirty monomials of P (the degree-6 30-monomial polynomial from verify_bautin_recurrence.py, transcribed in research/summaries/verify_bautin_recurrence.md), or state the identity over an explicit finite coefficient list. Certificate shape: put the generated coefficient data as UNTRUSTED defs under code/lean/Lib/Generated/ (no theorems inside Generated/), write the checker by hand OUTSIDE that folder, prove check = true iff the identity, and close with decide rather than native_decide. The kernel-checked identity 192*L6 + P30 = 0 over MvPolynomial is the deliverable. Report #print axioms and every remaining sorry.
fields.title: Spell out P30 in BautinRecurrence.lean via Generated/ and close 192*L6+P30=0 with decide

fields.detail: Directive 3 (FIRST): research/notes/lu-finite-core-verified.md claims the finite core was re-derived BY HAND with exact arithmetic (bridge identities, Darboux cofactors X(L)=(x+dy)L and X(F)=(2Bx+dy)F, deg-4 obstruction 8L4=AC+CD+2DF-EF, deg-6 relation) but there is NO executed program and NO capture anywhere in code/out for any of it - a measurement nobody can reproduce, which the workspace's own rule forbids building on. Write code/bautin/verify_lu_core.py, CLEAN-ROOM from the paper's stated definitions (not by importing the paper's scripts), exact rational or symbolic arithmetic via sympy, asserting the identities on the produced data (8*L4-(AC+CD+2DF-EF)=0, 192*L6+P30=0 with P30's 30 monomials, the Darboux cofactor equations, the 4 bridge identities). Capture the run to code/out/lu_core.captured.txt with the first three lines naming what ran, which definitions, and which identities. Then downgrade research/notes/lu-finite-core-verified.md from the by-hand claim: the algebraic identities it claims are UNVERIFIED until this executed run passes; keep the note's transcription as the source for P30's monomials but the status line must say what the executed run actually supports.
fields.title: Write code/bautin/verify_lu_core.py clean-room and capture to code/out/lu_core.captured.txt

fields.detail: Directive 3 (THIRD, and 'do that one first' - the pass's primary deliverable): Statement.lean still carries degree_at_most : True (asserts nothing) and the Set.ncard hole, so h16_2 still does not state H16.2. Make the type actually carry every hypothesis: replace degree_at_most : True with the real statement that each coordinate function of the field is in MvPolynomial (Fin 2) RR with totalDegree ≤ n (tie the Plane -> Plane map to the polynomial and bound its degree); fix the Set.ncard hole (ncard of an arbitrary set is 0 when infinite, so the claim trivially holds for infinite sets - the bounded-cardinality statement must be over finite sets or state finiteness explicitly); get the file compiling. The statement is the deliverable - report #print axioms and every remaining sorry once it compiles.
fields.title: Make h16_2 actually state H16.2: real degree_at_most and finite-count fix in Statement.lean

fields.detail: Directive 3 splits this into two concrete, ordered sub-jobs: (verify-lu-core-executable) the clean-room executable re-derivation with a capture the workspace can reproduce, and (p30-lean-generated-certificate) the kernel-closed P30 identity in Lean. Keep this as the umbrella for the wider question - what the paper leaves existential, the not-yet-fetched two remaining scripts, the overall standing of the H14_3 claim - and work its concrete parts through the two child tasks. Do NOT report the algebraic core as verified until the executed run has passed and is captured.
